caption:
Not more money. Not more things.

The Prophet ﷺ said wealth is not in having many possessions, but in feeling sufficiency in the soul. Tonight, look at what you already have before you scroll past it.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6446 · Grade: Sahih

Name one blessing you stopped noticing
